EXPEDITE DENIED

April 14, 2026
RE: SHN-[REDACTED]96

We denied your request for an expedited hearing.

The reason for denial is listed below. For a free interpretation of the letter please call 800-743-8525.

You have filed a request for a State Hearing concerning the denial by your managed care plan of a request for timely access to care to an addiction specialist. You also indicated that you are seeking reimbursement for out of pocket expenses for having to pay for an out-of-network provider. You indicated that you need an expedite hearing due to the imminent risk of seizures and hospitalization. All documentation submitted has been reviewed and considered. Unfortunately, there is insufficient information at this time that you qualify for an expedited hearing where it must be shown that taking the time for a standard resolution could seriously jeopardize the enrollee's life, physical or mental health, or ability to attain, maintain or regain maximum function. If you have additional information to support the need for an expedited hearing, you may contact the State Hearing Division to renew your request. We will continue to schedule your hearing as quickly as possible on the regular hearing calendar.

Your case will be heard on a regular hearing calendar. You will get a separate notice of your hearing date and time.

If you think we made a mistake or your situation changes, you can ask again. We may need proof of your reason.

If you have any questions about this letter you may call 800-743-8525, or contact the State Hearings Division in one of the ways below:

• Online Appeals Account: https://acms.dss.ca.gov/acms/
• Email: ScopeOfBenefits@dss.ca.gov
• Fax Number: 833-281-0903
• Mail To: (Allow at least 5 days for mailing. Keep your originals.)
